decision: Vertical scan shots: pairs reuse the long-form solved cameras cropped to a 607.5x1080 window (sensor narrowed + lens shift via scan-process portrait.py, no re-solve); x0 (1920 coords): V_MATCH_FRONT 531, V_PAIR_3 150, V_MATCH_REAR 480, V_PAIR_2 850 (double for 3840)
why: Frame 1 must equal the IRL 9:16 window exactly; windows chosen to keep the matched part of the car plus the scanner/host action; checked by onion + edge overlay per pair

decision: V_RES_FULL: front-left 3/4, car 70-80 % of width, 39-63 % of height; 15 fps 810x1440 renders encoded to 1080x1920 + 30 fps preview, PNGs deleted after encode
why: Brief: car large with top 22 % / bottom 25 % clear for text/UI; front-right and rear-left wells are ragged; disk is ~6.9 GB
